questions.question_text: Premānand Swami kahe chhe ke hamāre man dūsro na bhāve?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan by Premanand Swami states: "Hamāre man svāminārāyaṇ dūsro na bhāve..."

questions.question_text: Aṇimādik aṣhṭ siddhi muktikun na chā've, Sabko phal _______ charan chitta lāve.
questions.explanation: The Kirtan by Premanand Swami states: "Aṇimādik aṣhṭ siddhi muktikun na chā've, Sabko phal sahajānand charan chitta lāve..."

questions.question_text: Jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe, jībhā ______ kaheshe. (Shloka 48)
questions.explanation: The Kirtan (Shloka 48) states: "Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe, jībhā svāmī sahajānand kaheshe;"
questions.source_reference: Kirtan (Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe...) Shloka 48

questions.question_text: Kān nahi suṇe bījo uchchār, netra nahi juve ______. (Shloka 49)
questions.explanation: The Kirtan (Shloka 49) states: "Kān nahi suṇe bījo uchchār, netra nahi juve bījo ākār;"
questions.source_reference: Kirtan (Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe...) Shloka 49

questions.question_text: Shloka 50 pramāṇe, buddhi nahi kare nishche _______ vinya.
questions.explanation: The Kirtan (Shloka 50) states: "buddhi nahi kare nishche hari vinya;"
questions.source_reference: Kirtan (Paṇ jiyā lagī prāṇ raheshe...) Shloka 50

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe karvāmā āvel shubh karma bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ _______ arthe thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ga.Ma.11 states: "...e ja shubh karma chhe te bhaktirūp thaīne kevaḷ mokshane arthe thāy chhe."

questions.question_text: Sharīrnu daman ne ______ e be vānā gṛuhasth satsangīne paṇ jarūr rākhyā joie, tyāre tyāgīne to jarūr rākhyā ja joie.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut Ka.3 states: "Sharīrnu daman ne vichār e be vānā to gṛuhasth satsangīne paṇ jarūr rākhyā joie, tyāre tyāgīne to jarūr rākhyā ja joie."

questions.question_text: Koṭi yagna jeṭlu ek _______ vratnu faḷ kahyu chhe.
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite states: "Koṭi yagna jeṭlu ek ekādashīnā vratnu faḷ kahyu chhe."

questions.question_text: Bhagwāne kahyu chhe ke ekādashīne divase ajāṇtā paṇ anna khāy chhe te ______ bāṇ māre chhe.
questions.explanation: Purushottam Bolya Prite states: "Vaḷī, bhagwāne kahyu chhe ke ekādashīne divase ajāṇtā paṇ anna khāy chhe te mane chhātīmā bāṇ māre chhe."

questions.question_text: Brahmānand Swami kahe chhe ke ______ maḷyāno upāy chhe. (Koḍe 3)
questions.explanation: Brahmanand Swami Kirtan (Koḍe 3) states: "Avināshī maḷyāno upāy chhe re..."
